title: Search a module context.md for its Lessons heading at any size in chough next, as REQ-cli-034 requires, instead of skipping one over 4 MiB
description: Search a module context.md for its Lessons heading at any size in chough next, as REQ-cli-034 requires, instead of skipping one over 4 MiB
no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-cli-034, added by change read-native-specsync-spec-files-under-specs-at-any-size-chough-s-65536-byte-structured-record-bound-no-longer-applies on the same pull request, already states this behavior; this change only covers src/main.rs, which that change's approved paths did not list
acceptance_criteria: `chough next` reports the 1-based line of `## Lessons` in a module context.md larger than 4 MiB, CRLF included, and `no Lessons section` for one without it, never a size note
tests/next.rs::next_searches_a_context_md_larger_than_4_mib fails before the fix and passes after it, and the existing lessons pointer test still passes

answers.constraints: REQ-cli-034 and its public contract change are declared and approved in change read-native-specsync-spec-files-under-specs-at-any-size-chough-s-65536-byte-structured-record-bound-no-longer-applies on the same pull request; this change only covers src/main.rs, which implements it.
